title: Enj Vichray Haye Do Bhen Bhira
body:
Enj Vichray Haye Do Bhen Bhira
<<DIVIDER>>
Shakal-e-Rasool Turya Shakal-e-Batool Nu, Hai Kehkay Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Hanjuan Dey Motiyan Da, Sehra Saja Kay Sughra, Jadon Veer Kohl Aaee,
Bari Dair Taeen Roya, Dhukyari Bhen Nu, Chan Veer Seenay La
<<DIVIDER>>
Samaan Safran Da, Rakheya Si Jere Valay, Akber Ne Mehmala Te,
Minataan De Naal Sugra, Hath Dowain Jor K, Payi Kardi Iltija
<<DIVIDER>>
Khali Gharan Dey Vairray, Jub Tey Hawaley Karkay, Javeen Tun Veer Akbar,
Lagda Ay Teray Bajon, Marjana Bhen Ney, Sawaan Da Ki Wasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Phupiyan Ne Jandi Vari, Sugra Nu Seenay La K, Doh Kitiyan Vasitan,
Nanay De Deeway Baleen, Rakhi Khas Tu Khiyal, Babay De Ghar Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Feherist Jeray Walay Ghazi Ney Par Kay Vekhi, Zainab Da Naam Parh Ah,
Baysakhta Akhiyan Cho, Athru Nikalgaey, Bara Roya Bawafa
